activity.notes: Bernhard Riemann published 'Ueber die Anzahl der Primzahlen unter einer gegebenen Grösse' (On the Number of Primes Less Than a Given Magnitude) in November 1859, outlining the connection between zeros of the zeta function and the distribution of prime numbers and stating the hypothesis now known as the Riemann hypothesis. This is an independently sourced publication-year scholarly milestone distinct from his 1854 geometry lecture; the hypothesis is not claimed as proven. Göttingen remained within the Kingdom of Hanover until 1866.
